_help: Worlds where players take NO damage (kubejs/server_scripts/serversetup/worlddamage.js).
protected_worlds : world ids, as /worlddamage shows them in game (or the F3 screen). Every world that is NOT in
this list (Survival, Wild, Resource, ...) has normal damage.
Worlds on this server: multiworld:hub, multiworld:rpg, multiworld:survival, multiworld:wild,
allow_void_and_kill : true = falling into the void and /kill still work in protected worlds (nobody falls forever).
enabled          : false = no world is protected (normal damage everywhere).
Only players are protected. Mobs and NPCs are not affected by this file.
